crux: pixel length of the fish: snout-to-tail ~640-670 px (C1) vs 835-845 px from the grey wedge ahead of the black shadow at frames 6-8 (DeepSeek), plus centroid vs template pixel speed
fault_found: DeepSeek's front point at frame 8 sits ~370 px ahead of the head ref point while the fish's snout stays 172-202 px ahead of it in every frame, so the 845 px includes the shadow; its centroid speeds (20.8-22.5 px/frame) are below the 23.6-23.7 px/frame of three independent tracks
lesson: When a cast shadow overlaps an object in some frames, check each extremity's offset from a rigidly tracked point on the object across all frames; a feature whose offset jumps belongs to the shadow, not the object.
